code.commit_subject: variants FINDINGS 3: unseen-bench bug + fix, baselines (seed 175/200 vs supervised 134/200), control rows

conclusion: Recorded arena row (v2 pair, bench450; 1200 expansions, k=5, prefix-check, replay-certified).
variant_conclusion: A solid solver but far from perfect play; the self-play line later beats it clearly - which is exactly the comparison it exists to anchor.
variant_description: A planner that works backwards from the goal, taught by copying a perfect solver's answers, with one network per board size. This is the study's main reference point: every later experiment must beat it. Technically: PolicyTF policy + LoopedValueNet value pairs trained on exact solver labels, benched at a fixed search budget of 1200 expansions (positions the search may examine), every solution physics-replayed before it counts.
